tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs and secondary buttons that sit on surface. Text on it uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header, hovered rows, disabled controls. Text on it uses ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: row dividers, panel edges. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and the table header rule; at least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps and table column labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action fill, links, focus ring, completed steps. As text it reads on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row and ghost-button hover. Text on it uses ink or brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons drawn on a brand or status-danger-fg fill.

tokens.name: status-neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Badge text for Draft and Closed on status-neutral-bg.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Badge ground for Draft and Closed.

tokens.name: status-progress-fg
tokens.usage: Badge text for Submitted, Validated and Sent to ERP on status-progress-bg.

tokens.name: status-progress-bg
tokens.usage: Badge ground for in-flight statuses.

tokens.name: status-success-fg
tokens.usage: Badge text for Confirmed and Fulfilled on status-success-bg.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Badge ground for Confirmed and Fulfilled.

tokens.name: status-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Badge text for Retrying (ERP unavailable, request queued) on status-warning-bg.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Badge ground for Retrying.

tokens.name: status-danger-fg
tokens.usage: Badge text for Rejected on status-danger-bg; fill of the danger button and failed step marker (text on it uses on-brand).

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Badge ground for Rejected.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Order sent to Odoo and confirmed.
styles.usage: Default text, table cells at 13px use data-sized overrides in DataTable.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers and field labels; set in uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Order numbers, ERP record IDs, correlation IDs and timestamps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a badge or button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; timeline column gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between timeline steps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Panels on the page use line, not shadow.
